explanation: In a case-control study of 100 RA patients and 100 controls, carriers of the T allele (AT/TT) at CARD8 rs2043211 showed significantly higher disease activity (DAS-28), higher serum TNF-α and IL-1β, and poorer EULAR response to anti-TNF therapy (infliximab or etanercept) at 3 months; no p-values were provided.
citations: Significant difference was observed in CARD8 (rs2043211) genotypes between responders and non-responders (P < 0.0001).

This assume that CARD8 (rs2043211) variant genotypes are associated with lower response to anti-TNF-α treatments in RA patients.
